decisionBasisNotes: The name CoreTend was selected and approved directly by the project owner. This session did NOT perform an independent trademark or prior-usage search for CoreTend, and no such search is claimed here. The CLEAR_FOR_ENGINEERING status therefore reflects an explicit human decision to proceed with a local technical rename, not a completed clearance investigation.

domainFindings.notes: Product site is planned as a subdomain of the owner's existing root domain ahmetbsbnr.com. No new domain is being acquired, which removes the domain-acquisition and domain-reputation risk class entirely. Not deployed by this session; no DNS record was created or modified.

decisionRuleApplied: Engineering clearance and publication clearance are separated. A locally-built, unpublished, unsigned artifact carries no trademark-use-in-commerce exposure, so the owner's decision is sufficient to authorise the technical rename. Publication remains blocked until legalReviewStatus == 'accepted' in the approval file, which requires a real registry search that this session did not perform.
outstandingForPublication: Trademark search in the relevant classes (Nice class 9 / 42) across EUIPO, INPI, USPTO, UKIPO, WIPO.
Prior-software-usage search for 'CoreTend' and 'coretend' across GitHub, app stores, and package registries.
Domain and handle confirmation for any public identity beyond coretend.ahmetbsbnr.com.
Legal identity and security contact for public-facing legal pages.
